name: commit
description: Execute an approved planning-git-commits plan: commit grouped changes in order, then optionally push.
template:
You have an approved commit plan from the planning-git-commits skill. Execute it exactly as approved.

Required scope — these files MUST appear in the commits: {{scope}}

The plan may contain more than the scope. If it omits any file listed above, stop before committing and say which ones are missing.

1. Check for pre-commit hooks.
   - No hooks: commit every planned commit normally, in plan order, each with its grouped files and message.
   - Hooks present: commit all but the last planned commit with --no-verify, then commit the last one normally. That runs the hooks once instead of once per commit.

2. If the hooks pass, offer to push (planning-git-commits step 5, optional): determine the remote and branch, confirm with the user, then push. Never force-push.

3. If the hooks fail:
   - Simple failure (lint or auto-format): fix it, re-stage with `git add --`, retry once.
   - Anything else (test or type failures), or the retry fails: stop, show the log, and ask the user. Never loop.
